headline: New list of disposition stocks! 4 hot stocks 'locked up'; from 8/24, matching every 2 minutes
summary: The Taiwan Stock Exchange and Taipei Exchange added four stocks to the disposition list, including Quanxin (2455) and Yangcheng (3498). Trading in them will be suspended from August 24 to August 28, with matching every two minutes.
why: Disposition status is a regulatory measure that restricts trading in stocks, which affects liquidity and investor access for the named companies.
